name: BIG TWO
description: Career Poker is a commercial hierarchical shedding and climbing game, originally published in Germany as Karriere Poker, where players race to shed cards and improve their social rank from dishwasher to company boss.

content.text: Career Poker is a commercial hierarchical shedding and climbing game, originally published in Germany as Karriere Poker, where players race to shed cards and improve their social rank from dishwasher to company boss.
Career Poker was published by Hexagames in 1988 under the German title Karriere Poker and uses a large custom deck with wild cards.
4-8 players use the table arrangement described for Career Poker.
Dedicated deck with 8 suits of 13 cards plus four wild cards
Dedicated deck with 8 suits of 13 cards plus four wild cards, score area, and enough table space for play.
Prepare Dedicated deck with 8 suits of 13 cards plus four wild cards and deal or lay out cards according to the documented Career Poker rules before play begins.
